journey.name: AX-02 The row checkbox announces the action its tap performs
journey.description:
Covers NFR-09 where it is easiest to get wrong: a control that carries a description which is present but inaccurate, which reads as authoritative and is worse than a missing one.
REGRESSION GUARD (issue #9). This journey failed on the build of 2026-09-08. TaskRow set one static content description, task_list_action_toggle ("Mark complete"), regardless of state - so TalkBack told a user they could complete a task that was already done, while the checked state beside it said otherwise. The label is now picked on task.isCompleted.
Backlog task TB-308 verified NFR-09 by reading the code, which is exactly the class of defect reading does not catch.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Verify that the "Book dentist" row has a checked checkbox
Verify that the checkbox on the "Book dentist" row is described as "Mark incomplete"
Verify that the checkbox on every unfinished row is described as "Mark complete"
Tap the checkbox on the "Book dentist" row
Verify that the "Book dentist" row now has an unchecked checkbox described as "Mark complete"
